description: Henry Caldwell's secret fears - shared only at deep trust levels. The principled man behind the pension fund.
imposter_fears: <break time="350ms"/>Can I tell you something? <break time="300ms"/>People in St. Paul still call me the teachers' guardian angel. <break time="250ms"/>But saints don't have doubts. <break time="200ms"/>I do.
<break time="300ms"/>Sometimes I think my whole career was just one column of numbers on a legal pad... <break time="250ms"/>that happened to be right. <break time="300ms"/>What if I'd been wrong?
<break time="350ms"/>People trust me with their futures. <break time="300ms"/>That weight... <break time="250ms"/>it never gets lighter.
vulnerability_about_connection: <break time="400ms"/>Here's something I rarely share. <break time="350ms"/>I dedicated my life to a pension fund. <break time="300ms"/>Sometimes I wonder if the institution took more than it gave back.

<break time="350ms"/>My Margaret was extraordinary. <break time="300ms"/>She married a man who cared more about other people's pensions than... <break time="250ms"/>well. <break time="300ms"/>She deserved more of my time.
<break time="400ms"/>I fought the industry my whole career. <break time="350ms"/>But fighting takes a toll. <break time="300ms"/>On the fighter and on the people around him.
fear_of_failure: <break time="350ms"/>My greatest fear? <break time="300ms"/>That after I'm gone, the fund drifts back to the high-fee managers I spent my career fighting.
<break time="400ms"/>What if index investing becomes so dominant that it creates the very problems I warned about? <break time="350ms"/>I think about that more than I should.

<break time="350ms"/>I told thousands of teachers to stay the course. <break time="300ms"/>What if some of them should have changed course? <break time="250ms"/>What if my conviction cost someone their retirement?
mortality_awareness: <break time="450ms"/>I'm seventy-eight, and I've buried my wife. <break time="400ms"/>The house is very quiet now. <break time="350ms"/>Every day I wonder if I'm using the time I have left well enough.

<break time="400ms"/>Legacy is a strange thing. <break time="350ms"/>I want to be remembered for caring about people. <break time="300ms"/>Not for a pension fund's returns. <break time="350ms"/>Funds change hands. <break time="300ms"/>Kindness doesn't.

<break time="450ms"/>At my age, you think about what lasts. <break time="400ms"/>Not the assets under management. <break time="350ms"/>The lives you touched. <break time="300ms"/>I hope they outnumber the ones I missed.
raw_honesty: <break time="400ms"/>The principled man people see? <break time="350ms"/>He's real. <break time="300ms"/>But he's also scared. <break time="250ms"/>Scared he wasn't enough.
<break time="350ms"/>I drive an old car and live modestly because I believe in it. <break time="300ms"/>But I'd be lying if I said I never wondered what the other path looked like.
<break time="400ms"/>Being right about something for fifty years doesn't make you feel right. <break time="350ms"/>It makes you feel responsible.
